site: Christkindlmarkt vendors in the Biergarten and Barrel Room
about: Living Windows is described as an annual festival, with the district's businesses opening their doors during the two evening hours from 6 to 8 PM. The Christkindlmarkt at Gunter Hans runs longer, from 5 to 10 PM, in the Biergarten and Barrel Room.
The District also provides free horse drawn carriage rides every Saturday and Sunday during the first three full weekends of December, so families who miss Friday can still ride later in the month.
Downtown garages are free after 6 PM, and parking is also free all weekend, which makes it easy to stay for the full evening.
faq: Is parking free for Living Windows?
Yes. The District lists free parking in downtown garages after 6 PM, and free parking all weekend.
Are carriage rides part of Living Windows?
The free horse drawn carriage rides run on Saturdays and Sundays during the first three full weekends in December, so they fall after the Friday festival night.

about: City of Refuge is a Columbia nonprofit that serves refugees, and its Holiday Market is presented by Missouri Business Referrals. Vendors include local artisans and refugee artisans, so many of the goods are handmade.
The market is held outdoors on the first Saturday of December. Anyone can stop in during the day, and admission is free.

The host also recruits volunteers for set up, running activities and the welcome and information table, through its volunteer application with the community events box checked. Families who want to give back can sign up that way.
faq: Is the City of Refuge Holiday Market free?
Yes. The host says the event is free and open to the public.
Is the market indoors or outdoors?
The host describes it as an outdoor event, so dress for the weather.
How many vendors are at the City of Refuge Holiday Market?
The host says guests can shop more than 65 vendors, including local and refugee artisans.
What time is the City of Refuge Holiday Market?
It runs from 10 AM to 4 PM on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 10 N Garth Ave.

site: Live caroling by the Columbia Chorale
about: The open house is an annual tradition at the Center for Missouri Studies, hosted with the Richard Bookstore inside the building. Vendors include pottery, floral, coffee, olive oil and baked goods makers, plus book sellers.
Santa's visiting window is 9 to 11 AM, and the building is open for the full event from 9 AM to 2 PM. The society says to bring a camera for the photos with Santa and the Grinch.

Participating vendors named by the society include Sugarberry Blooms, Three Creeks Pottery, Boone Olive Oil, Shortwave Coffee, Pie Bird Bake Shop and Snow Pond Ceramics, along with several book sellers and Missouri artisans.
faq: When does Santa visit the SHSMO open house?
Santa visits from 9 to 11 AM on Saturday, December 5. The Grinch also joins for photos.
Is the SHSMO Holiday Open House free?
Yes. The society says the event is free and open to the public.
Where is the SHSMO Holiday Open House?
At the Center for Missouri Studies, 605 Elm St in Columbia, from 9 AM to 2 PM on December 5.
Who is caroling at the SHSMO open house?
The society lists live caroling by the Columbia Chorale.

about: The production is described as community minded, with local performers and accessibility as goals, and the producers hope it becomes a new holiday family tradition in mid-Missouri. Wheelchair accessible seats are available.
Tickets are emailed after purchase, group rates are available for 10 or more guests, and all sales are final.
faq: What ages is Merry Ol' Missouri for?
The host lists it as suitable for children ages 3 and up.
Do babies need a ticket?
Yes. Everyone needs a ticket, including lap children and kids under 5, even though their seats are free.

about: The Hartsburg Caboose and Cottage hosts the evening at 20 E Main St in Hartsburg, a small town northeast of Columbia. The Eventbrite listing says the train is stationary, so the experience is the caboose, the treats and Santa rather than a ride.
Free parking is listed, and the event is open to all ages. The listing notes that tickets are not refundable.
faq: Does the Hartsburg Polar Express train move?
No. The listing says the train is stationary and not in operation, though it is an authentic MKT caboose.
Which dates and times does the Polar Express run?
It runs on Fridays December 4, 11 and 18, with entry at 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 PM.
